BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to sexually altered, pinioned mute swans; andadding a new section to chapter 77.12 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 77.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A mute swan (Cygnus olor) may not be designated as deleteriousexotic wildlife under this chapter if all of the following criteria aremet: (1) The mute swan is both sexually altered and pinioned; (2) The mute swan is located on private property that containswater bodies totaling no more than twenty acres; and (3) There are no more than two mute swans located on each property.
